knowledgeSources.title: Undocumented expertise gets captured and made accessible and learnable for everyone.
knowledgeSources.subtitle: The most valuable knowledge is written down nowhere. It sits in your experts' heads and leaves with them. Scibly captures it before it is lost.

interview.title: Interviews
interview.description: Documentation records how something works. Scibly asks about the rest: the exceptions, the rules of thumb, the reasons behind decisions.
interview.question: You mentioned payment retries. What happens on a timeout?

artifacts.title: Everyday work supplies the evidence
artifacts.description: Scibly extracts knowledge from Slack messages, code reviews, tickets, and docs, and stores every insight with its source.
artifacts.slackText: Never retry twice, the gateway already does.

lesson.title: More than knowledge extraction
lesson.description: The extracted knowledge is not just stored centrally, it can be turned into interactive learning units automatically, at the push of a button.
lesson.quizQuestion: A request hits a timeout. Now what?
lesson.quizOptionRight: Check the booking status, don't retry

knowledge.title: Payment retries
knowledge.fact1: Retries are handled by the gateway only.
